//! Probe: silencing a prohibited call with `#[allow]` rather than `#[expect]`.
//!
//! The allow suppresses the `disallowed_methods` diagnostic, which is exactly
//! why the policy forbids it: the suppression would survive the site being
//! migrated. `clippy::allow_attributes` is what must object instead.

#[allow(clippy::disallowed_methods, reason = "an allow must not be accepted")]
pub fn reads() {
    let _ = std::env::var("WILDSIDE_PROBE");
}
